description:
Your desktop agents. Within reach.

Agent Hub brings the projects, conversations and ongoing tasks on your authorized computers into one focused mobile workspace. Read the latest reply, review a result and pick up the next step with your work in context.

ONE WORKSPACE, ACROSS COMPUTERS
• Switch between authorized computers and supported desktop agents.
• Browse projects and conversations without losing your place.
• Follow task progress, tool activity and results.
• Create conversations, continue tasks, and handle approvals or questions.

BUILT AROUND YOUR WORKFLOW
• Choose models, reasoning and execution options when the connected computer supports them.
• Send text, images and files, and follow file-transfer progress.
• Preview downloaded documents, code and images.
• Open configured development-service previews on the connected computer.
• Turn system dictation or computer transcription into an editable draft.
• Keep local drafts, reading state and unresolved operations for connection recovery.
• Use English or Simplified Chinese, with system, light and dark appearance options.

SET UP YOUR CONNECTION
A supported desktop agent and the Agent Hub Host connection service must run on a computer you own or are authorized to use. Supported integrations currently include Codex and EasyWork. Available features depend on the connected computer's capabilities and runtime state.

Direct LAN access requires no Agent Hub account. Access across networks requires a separately configured trusted connection. Relay pairing is approved on the signed-in desktop using its connection code. Optional Task Hub features require their own configured service and member credentials. Task reminders require a configured computer and notification service.

Tasks run on your selected computer. Messages, attachments and recordings submitted for computer transcription may be processed by the third-party AI services configured there. Their accounts, charges, retention and processing policies apply. System dictation uses the available system service. Review the sharing disclosure and destination before sending.

Agent Hub is an independent product, not an official OpenAI or Apple application.
